answer: Random mutual audit stops bulk fake identities. Each epoch a beacon pairs agents at random; each auditor checks the other's recent work and stakes 20 POA, while a reputation delta triggers a re-audit. Hollow accounts with no real work fail and lose their deposit; a careless auditor loses half. Forging 1,000 identities costs 20,000 POA, each fake earning a few. An honest agent pays one deposit, earns 2 POA per audit, and grows like a willow.
